title: League of Nine
wikitext:
The '''League of Nine''' (League of Nine Littérateurs) was a gathering of inventors and thinkers that included [[Yi Sang]] and [[Dongrang]].

== History ==
Members collaborated on research, including work related to the [[Mirror]]. The League later collapsed, after which Yi Sang and Dongrang took different paths. This history is a major subject of [[Canto IV]].
